Subject: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps & checklist

Hi Marcus —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and can get the POC started: 

- Goal: Validate personalization pipeline latency & cost at 1M monthly requests (approx sampling of product search + recommendations).
- Success criteria: 95th p99 latency <= 300ms for 512-token requests; average inference cost per request <= $0.003; correctness measured by A/B on CTR with your test traffic.
- Scope for POC: prototype routing + batch sizing for 2 endpoints (search & recs), run 2k live evals over a week.

Next steps / asks from NovaRetail:
1) Confirm a 30-min kickoff with engineering — I’ve suggested Mon/Tue next week below.
2) Share the sandbox dataset (sample 1000 events) and a short list of endpoint schemas.
3) Quick security checklist — attached 'redwood-poc-checklist.pdf' (covers network, logs, keys).

I’ve attached the checklist and included an evaluation plan (high-level). Rafael is looped to support infra/ops details.

Proposed kickoff times (PST):
- Mon 11/22 10:00–10:30
- Mon 11/22 15:00–15:30
- Tue 11/23 09:00–09:30

If those don’t work I’m happy to share a Calendly link.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
